1.consolidated_definition: pol. Miembro del comité nacional de un partido de Estados Unidos. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. El presidente de la Cámara de Representantes y National Committee Man del Partido Republicano en Puerto Rico, Edison Misla Aldarondo, comenzó a mover sus influencias entre sus correligionarios del Partido Nuevo Progresista, pero que son democratas, para que el fiscal federal interino Guillermo Gil sea reemplazado (El Nuevo Día, 20-02-98)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Member of the national committee of a U.S. party. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. The President of the House of Representatives and National Committee Man of the Republican Party in Puerto Rico, Edison Misla Aldarondo, began to move his influence among his fellow partisans from the New Progressive Party, but who are Democrats, for the acting federal prosecutor Guillermo Gil to be replaced (The New Day, 20-02-98)
